extension.description: Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: Adds Kodi home + sources directories to File Manager. (v1.0.21 skipped optional dependencies — no more pulling Google Drive / cloud resolvers you didn't ask for. The installer now matches Kodi's own behaviour and resolves only required dependencies; optional imports stay on-demand. (v1.0.20 made Setup remove itself after a successful run. v1.0.19 stopped pinning Setup to the home screen and made the MOD V2 patch manual-only. v1.0.18 added the end-of-setup restart prompt.)
